title: Simple zeros on the critical line for a weighted family of Dirichlet L-functions, from polylogarithmic to polynomial height
description:
Paper (74 pages), Lean 4 formalisation and verification records.

Unconditionally, for a weighted family of primitive Dirichlet L-functions, at least 0.9322 − ε of the zeros at polylogarithmic height are simple and on the critical line (Theorem 1.1), with explicit bounds up to any fixed polynomial height in the conductor (Theorem 1.4; for example 0.8656 − ε for T ≤ Q, and above 2/3 at every polynomial height). Theorems 1.1 and 1.4(a) are machine-checked in Lean 4, with no hypotheses and only the standard axioms.

Preprint, September 2026; not yet peer-reviewed. The mathematics, proofs, Lean formalisation and text were produced by AI agents (Anthropic's Claude Opus 5.5) under the author's direction; see the paper's AI-use statement and docs/VERIFICATION.md.
